notes.title: Scream and Scores!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/7143c28dbe69495cd9fe5fbe2f8d10ea94ec3b8d.png[/img]

[h3]Hello Arcane Hunters, recently there have been sightings of creatures wandering into other regions, I believe these are not the things you are used to but we need to take action.
It is our duty as Masters of the Occult to study and catalog the supernatural.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/971c4b356df076e0376cc512fd5d3691c81cad6e.png[/img]

[h3]It is only natural that in the life of an Arcanist we accumulate some achievements, your first hunt, the first clue, the first capture, are all magical moments... so why not add this to our story? Well, now we will have STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS, a milestone for everyone who has ventured into the world of Grimhunt.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/944e3f0b71a6b2c9ab0150669a691bdfda12b905.png[/img]

[h3]Now our community has grown and is getting stronger, so we will make a prestigious scoreboard for the best hunters in 5 categories: Catalogs, Slaughter, Purge, Capture and Level.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/3dd895850fc9c5c17e7c6018b4f306eea7d2d075.png[/img]

10 new creatures.
New Cemetery Map.

The new update will arrive soon with many and many new features including creatures, items, maps, sounds, weather and much more.

notes.notes:
Hello again hunters, I bring you some information about the next update, I am working hard on the engine and this will be noticeable in the menu and in-game.

Thanks to the attention Hunters, soon I will bring more news!

notes.title: Monster Hunter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/7143c28dbe69495cd9fe5fbe2f8d10ea94ec3b8d.png[/img]

Hello again hunters, today I come with a lot of news, first thank you to those who point out Bugs and defects, I am very happy to fix and make this game better and better!!!
Now let's go to the update.

Many things have been changed from the menu to the way to play, now the game is segmented into 3 stages core:
-Investigate.
-Hunt, Purge or Capture.
-Results.

The investigation you already know, search for clues and find out what the creature is.
The second stage is more comprehensive in possibilities and requires a pre-designed strategy.
Example:

-After finding out what type of creature I start placing Traps on the ground and attacking with arrows to decrease its life, then use the Capture Net to finish.
(Captures grant bonus Exp and Gold).

-Once I make friends with the creature, using the Meat Bait or Fruit Bait I can raise the friendship to the maximum and finish the hunt without any death. ( Bonus for friendship ).

notes.title: Request a Quest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/7143c28dbe69495cd9fe5fbe2f8d10ea94ec3b8d.png[/img]

[h1]Request a Quest[/h1]

Hello again my Hunters, Today I will present the Quests system.
The Arcane community depends on the collaboration and exchange of information from all hunters, it is up to you to help in the accumulation of information about new regions and creatures... With this in mind we have created a quest system, which will help us systematize the collection of information and resources.
The more quests you complete, the more rewards!

Currently the system already has 12 different types of quests that will be delivered according to the needs of the quest giver. ( New objectives and goals will be added in the future )

Added creature Aura, 3 possible models, flash, black smoke, fade.
Improved fog in the environment.
Balancing of prices and rewards.
Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Artifact or Artifake
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/7143c28dbe69495cd9fe5fbe2f8d10ea94ec3b8d.png[/img]

Hello my Arcane Hunters, who among us has never dreamed of being an archaeologist? finding crystal skulls, running away from rolling stones, being bitten by snakes? Ahhh the dream...
Thinking about this I am introducing the concept of Artifacts, objects scattered around the world that tell a little about the region, for now they are very simple, a small fraction of the story, a nonsense here and there but very soon will be a significant part of the hidden world.

Update:
Shrubs are now clickable. 10% chance to drop clues.
Added Archaeology system ( still in development ).
Added 4 Artifacts to the Forest map, Copper Pyramid, Obscure Stone, Rusty Sword, Kah-Ri Crystal. 
Collecting artifacts earns XP and Money.

notes.title: Open mind, Closed Body.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/7143c28dbe69495cd9fe5fbe2f8d10ea94ec3b8d.png[/img]

[h1]Open Mind, Closed Body[/h1]

Hello, Arcane Hunters.
Great additions this week, in view of the fact that the hunts were.... tedious, a new system, "Sanity" has been added. 
It's good to keep your head on straight, this job can be stressful, with the new system the creatures can interact with you, but not in a cute and friendly way, in a grotesque and aggressive way. Listening to noises in the forest will also affect your head and make you dizzy.
But it's not all trouble, the new HEALTH METER has arrived!
An amazing device that measures your ability to make decisions, directly connected to your nerves, it picks up your heartbeat and your shaking! The Boss has gone crazy! Buy now with double discount for half off!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358866/19491fc8d809fbd1d9a3744c4edecc9fc0db9b06.png[/img]

We have also added to the store:

-Thermometer / For tracking creatures of various temperatures. Fire? Cold corners? that's what you need!

-EMF / Absolutely every paranormal hunter needs one, this is the pinnacle of technology in tracking down clues ( Although it sounds like a broken radio ).
